# Pixel Memory Match

A pixel-themed memory-match game with 8 pairs of colored cards.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total in a 4x4 grid)
- Flip two cards at a time to find matches
- Matched pairs stay open
- Move counter updates with each pair flip
- Win message appears when all pairs are matched
- "New Game" button to reset
- Keyboard accessible with ARIA labels
- Responsive design down to 360px width

## How to Play

1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Click or tap a card to flip it.
3. Flip a second card to try to find a match.
4. If the cards match, they stay open.
5. If not, they flip back after a short delay.
6. Continue until all 8 pairs are matched.
7. Use the "New Game" button to start over.

## Tech Stack

- HTML5
- CSS3 (system fonts, CSS grid, transitions)
- Plain JavaScript (no libraries or frameworks)

## Accessibility

- All interactive elements are keyboard accessible
- Cards have descriptive ARIA labels
- Focus indicators are visible
- Move counter and win message use `aria-live` regions

## Development

No build step required. Simply open `index.html` in a browser.
